violation_type.title: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child (26 TAC §747.605(14))
violation_type.short_title: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child
violation_type.typical_finding: Four children enrolled needed school information such as the name and phone number of the school they attend.

finding_variants.text: Four children enrolled needed school information such as the name and phone number of the school they attend.

It was noticed that the school name and phone number were not available in 2 school-aged children s records.   Note: The caregiver called the parents to obtain this information and placed it on the admission forms during the inspection.
Three school age children did not have information of the school they attend including permission for school-age children to ride bus or walk to and from school.

It was noticed that the school name and phone number were not available in 3 school-aged children s records.   Note: The caregiver called the parents to obtain this information and placed it on the admission forms during the inspection.
2 out of the 4 children's records reviewed were for school age children and were missing the name and phone number of the school the child attends.
A school age child did not have information on the school they attended.
